newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shares end mixed as merger rumors move market.
newsitem.headline: Lima shares end mixed as merger rumors move market.

text.p: Lima stocks closed mixed in the final session of the week as rumors of mergers and acquisitions combined with selective profit-taking to shape the day's trading, brokers said.
"There are rumors of mergers and acquisitions of food and brewery companies," said Roberto Atking, of Surinvest brokerage. "That creates expectations and interest in certain stocks."
Analysts warned that pending sale orders at the end of Friday's session could spell price falls for Monday.

"I don't think the optimism will return on Monday, so that could generate a fall," said Carlos Guimeth, of Multivalores brokerage. "However, we should take into account that the Peruvian economy is stronger than at the beginning of the year."
On Friday, the General Index edged down 0.10 percent to 1,437.05 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index rose by 0.14 percent to 1,975.86.
Total market volume was 30.9 million soles ($12.4 million) in 1,907 trades as 25 stocks fell, 21 rose and 42 were flat.
Benchmark Telefnica del Per accounted for 25.57 percent of trade, rising 0.52 percent to 5.77 soles on 1.36 million shares.
Edegel gained 1.16 percent to 6.08 soles on 607,382 shares -- 12 percent of the market's total -- and Luz del Sur was up 1.1 percent to 3.67 soles.
Biggest losers included Tejidos la Unin, off 12.5 percent to 0.14 sol on 193,117 soles and leader Consorcio Fabril Pacfico, which fell 4.32 percent to 3.1 soles on 548,730 soles.
